research_question: Can observation-level Agent labels be retained while eliminating subjective parent-natural-event grouping through a deterministic fixed-clip analysis-unit transform?
estimand: Descriptive observation-label agreement and deterministic fixed-unit reproducibility in a small fresh clip-level calibration; no population effect or causal estimand.
observational_unit: One frozen observation slot for label agreement; one predeclared fixed clip for the derived unit summary.
sampling_and_dependence: Six fixed clips, four observation slots per clip, three source sessions; slots within a clip are repeated views and are not independent samples. Results are CANARY_LITE and clip-level fresh, not session-level independent confirmation.
claim_ceiling: no human truth, objective sensor truth, model increment, traversability, product, or safety claim
non_goals: D0-AT, D0-B, effect evaluation, Android, or default-app changes

observation_contract.agent_responsibility: Label each frozen observation slot and record quality/rationale only. Do not merge, split, extend, or name events.
observation_contract.present_definition: A reviewable foreground or midground entity visibly blocks the background scene or terminates the central line of sight.
observation_contract.no_evidence_definition: The central ROI is reviewable but no qualifying visible central obstruction is present. This does not mean clear, safe, or obstacle-free.
observation_contract.not_evaluable_definition: The slot cannot support the observation because of severe blur, darkness, occlusion, turning/scene transition, title/edit frame, or another explicit visibility failure.
forbidden_positive_shortcuts: background building, ground, sky, water, distant figure, texture, or shadow alone
occupancy of the ROI without blocking the background or central line of sight
candidate output, YOLO, depth, segmentation, risk, feedback, or prior labels

analysis_unit.slot_order_rule: Choose the first source frame at or after start_ns + slot_offset_ns; require strictly increasing frame indices and bounded timestamp jitter.
analysis_unit.downstream_effect_rule: Only STABLE_PRESENT and STABLE_NO_EVIDENCE are eligible for a later fixed-unit diagnostic; MIXED_OBSERVATION and NOT_EVALUABLE are retained and excluded, never relabeled. This protocol does not authorize that later diagnostic.

fresh_calibration_selection.selection_rule: Use exactly three D0-A0 production-universe sessions not present in the burned D0-A1 calibration sources; select two windows at the frozen 0.25 and 0.75 session-duration fractions.

review_contract.unresolved_disagreement_policy: Retain raw disagreement; it counts against the unresolved gate. No D0-A3/A4 adjudication is started by this successor.

gates.decision_rule: All gates must pass; empty denominators, missing isolated evidence, invalid envelope, or any boundary mismatch fail closed. Observation agreement cannot repair a failed unit-state or envelope gate.

software.dependencies: standard library plus existing OpenCV used by the D0-A1 input freezer
software.statistical_status: descriptive calibration; no inferential test or population confidence claim
